esptool-js 0.7.0 (https://github.com/espressif/esptool-js), Apache License 2.0 - see LICENSE.
Used by the PTBOT Studio website for the first firmware install over USB. Not part of the page the robot serves.
bundle.js also contains pako (https://github.com/nodeca/pako, MIT and Zlib licences, (C) 2014-2017 Vitaly Puzrin and
Andrei Tuputcyn) and atob-lite (MIT, (C) 2015 Hugh Kennedy).
